note: Independent re-audit after 26d70dfa0d against RFC 4724 Section 4.2. First DOWN: retainPeerFamilies sends the same retain-routes on-down families for every family of the received GR capability, now reading the RIB answer (an empty earlier-connections list records nothing), then handleStructuredState sends the same peer-wide mark-stale with the Restart Time. newGRWithRealRIB now passes the RIB's real answers, so TestRFC4724SessionDownRetainsAndMarksRoutesStale exercises the answer-reading path and still requires IPv4 kept at stale level 1 with unadvertised IPv6 deleted, and both families at level 1 when both are advertised; TestRFC4724SessionDownWithoutCapabilityRetainsNothing requires deletion without the capability; TestRFC4724RetentionCoversEveryAdvertisedFamily and the state-manager pair are unchanged controls. The commit also closes a consecutive-restart hole (routes a later connection sent for a family already in LLGR were retained unmarked), now marked by restalePreservedLLGR and proven by the untagged-for-this-row real-RIB root TestRFC9494ConsecutiveRestartMarksTheLaterConnectionsRoutes.
